en-US.author: Mario Hidalgo G.
en-US.description: Local memory and context for you and your AI agent: Markdown notes, documents and tasks on your disk, with an MCP server for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
en-US.longDescription:
Tisty keeps what you know on your own machine: notes, documents and tasks, in plain
Markdown files you can read without it. Everything you do is written to an append-only
log, so nothing is lost by accident and a change can be walked back; erasing something
for good is the one step that cannot. No account, no
subscription, no telemetry, no server. Sync, if you want it, goes through a folder both
your machines already reach, and an assistant can come in through a door you open.
en-US.name: Tisty
en-US.releaseNotes:
Tisty 1.47.0
A brainstorm at hand, and your AI agent picks up where it left off without losing a thing
- The quick capture now takes ideas too: Tab switches between a task and an idea, and ideas have a shortcut of their own.
- Ideas wait as sticky notes in colours, up to 140 characters each, in a Brainstorm pinned atop your library, and you reorder them by dragging.
- When an idea's moment comes, it becomes a task or goes into the document on its subject, and the library counts the ones still waiting.
- Your AI agent brainstorms with you and jots only the ideas you keep; asked to sort them, it proposes which belong together, which become tasks and which go into documents.
- An idea you file in a document arrives as the same sticky note, with its date and its colour, and any document can carry one.
- A document with ideas is shared through Folio with them whole, their date, colour and side included.
- Brainstorm itself stays on your computer: its ideas travel in the documents they go into.
- Ideas it deems old are only marked, with the reason: you delete them or take the mark off.
- When it starts, your agent sees what moved since its last session, who moved it and which task it was on.
- If that task was closed or it said it was done, it tells you instead of taking another.
- It also sees your overdue tasks first, then those due soon, for today and late, so a monthly chore reaches it on its day.
- Your agent works any task the way it works a document, yours too: it describes it, renames it, moves it to another list, plans or rewords its open steps and writes its page.
- Ticking your steps, closing a task and moving its day stay yours.
- When your agent folds its notes on a task into one summary, you can ask it to put them back as they were, even after you ticked steps.
- Folding them never touches the notes you wrote yourself.
- A document that had its day is marked with the reason, and you delete it, archive it or take the mark off.
- When it joins two copies of a document, your agent tells you which translations and links are left to move.
- A long task reaches your agent in parts, with its summary and its latest note, so picking up costs less.
- Searches put last what was marked as old.
- Your agent strikes through and dates a decision that changes instead of erasing it.
- A document you archived is left alone until you bring it back.
- Diagrams read clearer: an arrow goes round a shape in its way, arrows reaching one shape come in apart without crossing, and the words on arrows no longer cover each other.
- Enter takes what you chose in the / menu, and the first icon among the views, All tasks, opens everything open across your lists.
- The guide gives ideas, the archive and your AI agent their own parts, with a page on connecting your agent, and shows fresh captures of the app.
- The help and the readme tell all of this, with real captures of Tisty, as memory for you and your AI agent.
What's Changed
- fix(mcp): tick, find, rename and language say when to use them and which tool to reach for instead by @rgdevment in #709
- fix(mcp): truer tool hints, refusals that tell a task's id from a document's, and missed steps listed by @rgdevment in #710

- feat(mcp): a new session picks up where the agent left off, and read shows the page and latest notes by @rgdevment in #711
- fix(release): Homebrew and the installers describe Tisty as local memory and context for you and your AI agent by @rgdevment in #713
- fix(mcp): catch_up keeps the news a retry needs, names the task really left, and read keeps to one read by @rgdevment in #714
- fix(mcp): a task page's digest can be undone, says what it folds, and tidying leaves nothing behind by @rgdevment in #715
- fix(mcp): pickup reads long task pages by section and notes by size, and lookups set marked docs apart by @rgdevment in #716
- fix(mcp): flag_doc reads as a mark, old decisions get struck, and put-away refusals say who restores by @rgdevment in #717
- docs: the help, readmes and store text say what the MCP does since 1.46, for you and your agent by @rgdevment in #718
- feat(docs): Brainstorm, a pinned board of sticky notes the quick capture fills with ideas by @rgdevment in #720
- feat(docs): a Brainstorm idea can be filed in a document or made a task, and the Library counts those waiting by @rgdevment in #721
- chore(release): the 1.47.0 news, upgrades from 1.46.0 met, and PRIVACY says an agent marks and archives by @rgdevment in #719
- fix(diagrams): an arrow goes round a shape in its way, and its words never cover another's by @rgdevment in #724
- docs: Brainstorm in the screens, help and guide, an idea defined, and diagrams, ideas and matrix first by @rgdevment in #722
- feat(mcp): an agent jots and sorts Brainstorm ideas, and marks old ones with a ◆ the sheet shows by @rgdevment in #723
- fix(diagrams): arrows meeting one side of a shape come in at points of their own, crossing none by @rgdevment in #725
- fix(sharing): the contract says Folio serves up to 16 editor revocations, 4 of each root first (1.9.2) by @rgdevment in #727
- feat(release): a minor version goes out with its news article in both… by @rgdevment in #728
- revert(release): a minor version no longer waits for a news article, … by @rgdevment in #731
- feat(ui): Enter takes the / menu's choice, and an inbox icon opens every open task by @rgdevment in #733
- feat(mcp): catch_up names the pressing tasks, overdue first, so a monthly chore reaches an agent on its day by @rgdevment in #732
- feat(markdown): an [!IDEA] sticky note in any document, and Brainstorm writes its ideas as one by @rgdevment in #726
- feat(mcp): an agent works any task as it works a document, while ticks, closing and the day stay the person's by @rgdevment in #734
- chore(release): the 1.47.0 news tell of ideas in documents, what presses, tasks worked as documents, diagrams by @rgdevment in #735
- docs: help, readmes and guide say an agent works your task as a document, and an idea fits in any document by @rgdevment in #736
- fix(mcp): ideas never share a heading, a hidden task's page stays shut, and a task's page goes by its task by @rgdevment in #737
- fix(ui): a window error keeps what the page said, and Chromium's resize notice is no longer logged as a break by @rgdevment in #738
- fix(ui): the PDF help shows whole, a wide table stays on its sheet, and an outside Markdown opens in front by @rgdevment in #739
- fix(sharing): a document with ideas is shared with their date, hue and side (contract 1.11.0) by @rgdevment in #740
- fix(mcp): a hidden task stays unnamed and unwritten, ideas keep fresh headings, long reads keep to their caps by @rgdevment in #741
- fix(sharing): Brainstorm never goes to Folio, the help shows an idea's date form, ammonia 4.2.5 by @rgdevment in #743

es.author: Mario Hidalgo G.
es.description: Memoria y contexto locales para ti y tu agente de IA: notas, documentos y tareas en Markdown en tu disco, con un servidor MCP para GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex y Cursor.
es.longDescription:
Tisty guarda lo que sabes en tu propio equipo: notas, documentos y tareas, en archivos
Markdown que puedes leer sin él. Todo lo que haces se escribe en un registro que solo
crece, así que nada se pierde por accidente y un cambio se puede deshacer; borrar para
siempre es el único paso que no. Sin cuenta, sin
suscripción, sin telemetría y sin servidor. La sincronización, si la quieres, pasa por
una carpeta que tus equipos ya alcanzan, y un asistente entra por una puerta que abres tú.
es.name: Tisty
